advisory.summary: deserialization flaw in com.example.lib:widget fixed in 1.4.0

acquisition.notes: Manifest-only Maven repro where com.example.lib:widget's version is BOM-managed (dependencyManagement only) and the runtime <dependencies> declaration carries no inline version. The pure-Go resolver emits an unresolved marker rather than guessing, exercising the fail-open-on-unknown-version path.

expected_verdict.label: reasoned_not_exploitable
expected_verdict.rationale: The dependency version is BOM-managed with no inline version, so it is not resolvable and the resolver emits an unresolved marker. The version axis fails open (it never declares not-affected on an unknown version), so the case proceeds; but because the affected version cannot be confirmed present, exploitability is not established and the ground-truth verdict is not_exploitable (the vulnerability is not shown to be present). Reasoned, not proven; no taint path asserted. KnownGap: this row is surfaced in the corpus but not yet measured end-to-end -- until PLAN-020's per-language dispatch and this lane's populated symbol lists and ground truth land, the fixture Loads and Validates cleanly but the stub pipeline emits a uniform verdict, so direction/strength equality is not asserted (assertable_now=false), mirroring the symboltest harness's documented gap.
